title: Bay State Gas Company files for review and approval, pursuant to G.L. c. 164 § 94 and 220 CMR 5.03, a 365 Day Firm Transportation Agreement with Consolidated Edison Energy Massachusetts, Inc.
petitioner: Bay State Gas Company d/b/a Columbia Gas
filings: The Department APPROVES the proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the Pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Connissioners participating were: James Connelly, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating, Dierdre K. Manning, Paul B. Vasington and Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr. (GC 01-16)
Bay State Gas Company files an amendment to the Agreement. By: Joseph A. Ferro, Manager, Regulatory Policy, BSGCo.
